attempts.name: four-head-draft
attempts.prompt: Create a beautiful polished CHARACTER DESIGN CONCEPT SHEET for an original cozy fantasy collection-and-journaling game. Landscape 3:2 illustration on a clean warm very pale sky-blue background. Two FULL BODY protagonists side-by-side with plenty of space, female on left, male on right, both in EXACTLY the same relaxed FRONT-FACING standing pose with feet grounded, arms hanging at sides slightly separated from torso, empty hands clearly visible outside the clothing silhouette. Their bodies and wardrobe are designed with modular interchangeable heads, hair, sleeves, hands, costumes and hats in mind, but show complete appealing assembled characters, NOT an exploded diagram. Proportions about 3.2 heads tall: cute, expressive, stylish young adult fantasy travelers with beautiful large lively TEAL anime eyes, small natural noses and warm smiles. Heads appropriately large, compact torso, visible legs, attractive simplified forms; NOT realistic anatomy, NOT infants, NOT blocky geometry, NOT cheap 3D dolls. Rich clean 2D cel painted anime game art with smooth beautiful linework and selective painterly fabric shading, saturated but sophisticated colors, strong easy-to-read silhouettes at phone size. Girl has a short slightly wavy chestnut bob with soft side-swept bangs, boy has a neat chestnut short layered cut. Matching world and same facial rendering quality. Matching mint-and-ivory explorer outfits: short jade/mint shoulder cape ending ABOVE elbows, small amber diamond clasp at collar, crisp ivory shirt, midnight navy short vest and shorts/skort on girl, navy shorts on boy, warm brown short adventure boots, cream socks. Slightly different costume details by gender but very consistent shared construction. Clear defined simple cuffs end at wrists. No long coats covering hands, no belts covered by objects, no extra limbs, no hand held items, no hats worn, no backpack, no wings, no weapons. Subtle gold accents, no busy embroidery. They should feel collectible and charming, with confident friendly personality and enough quality to want to dress up. Below and between them arrange ONLY three SMALL separate catalog item studies: a cream explorer beret, a tiny closed navy journal with a gold compass, and a small mint leaf brooch. Item studies are small, no attachment attempts. No UI panels, no borders, no game logos, no captions, no text. Soft grounding shadows beneath both characters. This is a genuinely new stylization, not a realistic illustration made shorter, and not borrowing any existing game's characters.

attempts.name: compact-chibi-pair
attempts.prompt: Redesign this pair as GENUINELY THREE-HEAD-TALL CHIBI collectible game protagonists, keeping the mint/navy/cream palette and friendly traveler personalities. The current reference is much too tall and has realistic long thighs. Make a striking proportional change: each enormous head including hair occupies a FULL ONE THIRD of the standing character height. Below chin, torso+legs+boots TOGETHER measure exactly TWO head heights. Enlarged round anime head, big brilliant teal eyes, compact shoulders, short rounded forearms with clearly separate visible mitt-like stylized hands, compact adorable boots and SHORT LEGS. Total 3.0 to 3.2 heads tall, never 4 or 5. Heroic cute young adult RPG chibi avatars, not babies, not toddler clothing, not dolls. Attractive high-quality clean cel illustration, thicker cohesive contours, broad calm color planes, just enough soft shading, selective fine detail on eyes/clasp. Warm appealing expressions. Simplify garments significantly: short mint cape, ivory sleeves, navy vest and skort/shorts, small amber clasp, brown short boots. Girl chestnut wavy bob, boy chestnut tousled crop. Front-facing neutral idle, arms hanging slightly away from bodies and empty hands visible clear of costumes, same shared pose. Match both proportions/style exactly. Preserve female-left/male-right design-sheet composition, warm pale blue background and soft grounding shadows. One small cream beret and one tiny navy journal centered between them at bottom. No texts, no panels, no extra poses, no decorative border. IMPORTANT: this is a newly illustrated chibi design, not a squeezed or warped version of the image. Prioritize cute strong readable silhouettes and easy wardrobe modularity over realistic anatomy or ornate clothing.

handheldPrototype.prompt: Create one isolated modular 2D anime game sprite: a slender RIGHT HUMAN HAND naturally carrying a SMALL CLOSED NOTEBOOK at the person's side with arm hanging straight down. Match the elegant clean cel-painted Japanese fantasy art, warm pale skin, line weight, and sky lighting of reference character. Reference book provides the navy leather, thin gold corners and gold compass design. Show ONLY the bare wrist, hand, and notebook. No sleeve, no arm above wrist, no person, no background, no cast shadow. Wrist enters from TOP near the RIGHT side of composition, vertical, flat crop edge; back of hand faces viewer. Fingers curl convincingly around the TOP RIGHT CORNER / upper short edge of the book, with thumb pressing visibly onto the front cover and other fingers curling behind the top edge. The notebook hangs DOWNWARD and extends mostly LEFT of the wrist, away from the body. Its front cover is visible in a restrained 3/4 view, NOT flat billboard. Relaxed anatomically believable carrying grip, not an open palm pasted over a book. Book palm-sized, about 1.6 hand lengths tall and 1.15 hand lengths wide; thin portable journal, no enormous tome. Simple small compass emblem, no words. Wrist, thumb, contact shadows and book must read as one connected natural grip. Flat transparent alpha background, no checkerboard, no white matte. Asset fills frame with small transparent margin. Single object, no variations.
